channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: British Pound: Growth distortions and rate risks – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Michael Pfister highlights unusually strong UK growth in the first quarter and weaker outcomes later in the year, driven largely by services. He argues this seasonal distortion complicates Bank of England policy signals, limiting conclusions from July’s robust data.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Likely trade sideways ahead of Fed-BoJ policy meetings
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) reflects a mixed performance against its major currency peers, but is significantly down against the US Dollar (USD), in the European trading session on Monday. As of writing, USD/JPY is up 0.44% to near 154.20.

item.title: Equities: Resilience versus rates and Oil shock – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team notes that equities advanced on Friday, leaving the broader market only about 1% lower for the week despite hotter US CPI, higher front-end yields and a sharp Oil rally. Cyclicals outperformed defensives and the VIX stayed below 16.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD hovers above a key support in the $63.00 area
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) shows minor losses at Monday’s early European session, amid a bearish near-term trend and with bears looking at a key support area around $63.00.

item.title: ECB’s Lagarde: The current shock is longer-lasting
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) President Christine Lagarde said in an interview on Saturday that the current energy shock is longer-lasting.

item.title: Gold: Sideways near support before FOMC – OCBC
item.description: OCBC strategist Christopher Wong reports Gold rebounded after United States (US) Consumer Price Index (CPI) as 10-year US yields and Oil eased, reducing inflation pressure on bullion.

item.title: Brent: Middle East risks support prices – ING
item.description: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note Brent is up around 3% as Saudi Arabia’s East-West pipeline shutdown intensifies supply concerns following recent attacks.

item.title: Euro: Support at 1.1565 watched against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang highlights that EUR/USD slipped to 1.1568 before rebounding to close near 1.1598, with downside momentum still limited. Intraday, the Euro (EUR) is expected to test major support at 1.1565 but a clear break is seen as unlikely, with resistance at 1.1605 and 1.1620.

item.title: British Pound weakens to near 1.3500 on Fed hike bets
item.description: The GBP/USD pair declines to near 1.3505 during the early European session on Monday. The US Dollar (USD) strengthens against the British Pound (GBP) as traders pondered possible rate hikes from the Federal Reserve (Fed) later on Wednesday.

item.title: British Pound trades higher at start of UK data-packed, BoE policy week
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is up against its major currency peers, except North American currencies, at the start of the United Kingdom (UK) data-packed week and the Bank of England’s (BoE) monetary policy announcement.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Retains bullish bias above mid-$98.00s and 61.8% Fibo.
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – kicks off the new week on a positive note, reversing a part of Friday's retracement slide from its highest level since May 21.

item.title: Swiss Franc weakens as US Dollar gains on Fed rate hike odds
item.description: USD/CHF extends its winning streak for the fourth consecutive day, trading around 0.8180 during Asian hours on Monday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) gains support amid aggressive Federal Reserve (Fed) rate-hike bets for Wednesday’s decision following hotter US inflation reports.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Holds steady near 110.00, bearish technicals persist
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades on a flat note near 110.10 during the early European trading hours on Monday.

item.title: Gold flat lines above $4,300 as firmer USD caps upside amid hawkish central bank bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to capitalize on Friday's modest bounce from sub-$4,300 levels and oscillates in a narrow band at the start of a new week as traders await key central bank events before placing fresh directional bets.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Slides to four-week low as hawkish Fed bets accelerate
item.description: The Euro (EUR) is down 0.28% to near 1.1565 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Monday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Monday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Trades near 178.50 after rebounding from descending channel bottom
item.description: EUR/JPY gains ground after registering losses in the previous day, trading around 178.30 during Asian hours on Monday. Technical analysis of the daily chart indicates the currency cross remains within the descending channel pattern, signalling an ongoing bearish bias.

item.title: United States Dollar Index rises to near 99.50 as Fed rate hike bets increase
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is gaining ground for the third consecutive day and trading around 99.30 during Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Shows resilience below 38.2% Fibo. near mid-0.7100s
item.description: The AUD/USD pair touches a one-and-a-half-week low, around the 0.7140 region during the Asian session on Monday, though it lacks follow-through. Spot prices currently trade just above mid-0.7100s, down nearly 0.25% for the day.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar weakens below 0.5800 on RBNZ dovish signals
item.description: The NZD/USD pair tumbles to around 0.5790 during the early Asian trading hours on Monday. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) weakens against the US Dollar (USD) on a dovish hike from the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ).

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD bears have the upper hand below $64.75-$64.85 confluence
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) kicks off the new week on a subdued note and oscillates in a narrow band above the $64.00 mark through the Asian session as traders seem hesitant to place directional bets ahead of key central bank event risks.

item.title: Canadian Dollar gains support from higher oil prices amid Saudi pipeline disruptions
item.description: USD/CAD halts its three-day winning streak, trading around 1.3870 during Asian hours on Monday. The pair inches lower as the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) receives support from elevated oil prices.

item.title: Japanese Yen edges lower vs USD amid Middle East jitters as Fed, BoJ meetings loom
item.description: The USD/JPY pair attracts some buyers at the start of a new week and climbs closer to the 154.00 mark during the Asian session, reversing a part of Friday's losses.

item.title: Gold edges lower below $4,350 on imminent Fed rate hike
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) loses ground to near $4,340 during the early Asian trading hours on Monday. The precious metal remains under selling pressure as hotter-than-expected US inflation data raised prospects that the Federal Reserve (Fed) will hike interest rates later this week.

item.title: WTI rebounds toward nearly four-month highs after Saudi pipeline shutdown
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price rebounds after falling nearly 4% in the previous trading day, hovering around $99.40 per barrel during Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: British Pound consolidates above 1.3500 vs USD ahead of this week's UK data, Fed, BoE
item.description: The GBP/USD pair struggles to capitalize on Friday's bounce from the vicinity of the monthly swing low and consolidates above the 1.3500 psychological mark at the start of a new week.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7698 vs. 6.7743 previous
item.description: On Monday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7698 compared to Friday's fix of 6.7743 and 6.7083 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Euro softens below 1.1600 as markets price in Fed rate hike
item.description: The EUR/USD pair declines to near 1.1585 during the early Asian session on Monday. The pair extends the decline amid aggressive Federal Reserve (Fed) rate-hike bets following hotter US inflation reports. Traders brace for the Fed interest rate decision later on Wednesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar declines to near 0.7150 as hot US inflation data boost case for Fed rate hike
item.description: The AUD/USD pair edges lower to around 0.7160 during the early Asian session on Monday. Stronger-than-expected US inflation reports provide some support to the US Dollar (USD) against the Australian Dollar (AUD). All eyes will be on the US Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate decision on Wednesday.

item.title: Iran says commercial vessel struck in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iranian state media claimed an Iranian commercial vessel was struck in the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday, killing one person, amid an ongoing conflicts between the United States (US) and Iran for control over the crucial energy chokepoint, CNN reported.
